name: a pill morphs into a box that opens on a tiny glowing scene
looks: A plain black pill shape sits alone on an empty field, then reshapes into a small square icon with a hinged lid. The lid tips open and a tiny glowing scene sits inside it: a lone figure walking toward a bright doorway, small enough to feel like a peephole into another world.
build: Pill-to-icon shape tween on border-radius/width/height (power3.inOut); the lid rotates open from its hinge on back.out for a slight overshoot; the inner scene starts playing only once the lid passes a threshold angle.
sound: A soft mechanical click as the shape resolves, a creak on the lid opening, a faint ambient tone from inside.
prompt: Morph a simple pill shape into a small icon with a hinged lid, tip the lid open with a slight overshoot, and reveal a tiny glowing scene inside, a figure walking toward a bright doorway, like a peephole into another world, as the opening tease before the payoff shot.
